title: Doubly robust inference via calibration
abstract: arXiv:2411.02771v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Doubly robust estimators are widely used for estimating average treatment effects and other linear summaries of regression functions. While consistency requires only one of two nuisance functions to be estimated consistently, asymptotic normality for linear functionals typically requires sufficiently fast convergence of both. We address this mismatch by showing that calibrating the nuisance estimators within a doubly robust procedure can yield doubly robust asymptotic normality. We introduce the idea of calibrated debiased machine learning (DML) and propose a specific implementation in which standard DML is augmented with a simple isotonic regression adjustment. We show that, under a partial orthogonality condition, a calibrated DML estimator remains asymptotically normal if either the regression function or Riesz representer of the functional is estimated sufficiently well, allowing the other to converge arbitrarily slowly or

translated_title: 通过校准实现双重稳健推断
translated_abstract: 摘要：双重稳健估计器广泛用于估计平均处理效应和回归函数的其他线性概括。虽然一致性仅要求两个干扰函数中的一个被一致估计，但线性泛函的渐近正态性通常要求两者都有足够快的收敛速度。我们通过证明在双重稳健程序内校准干扰估计器可以产生双重稳健的渐近正态性，来解决这一不匹配问题。我们引入了校准去偏机器学习（DML）的概念，并提出一种具体实现，其中标准DML通过简单的等渗回归调整进行增强。我们证明，在部分正交性条件下，如果回归函数或泛函的Riesz表示者之一被足够好地估计，校准的DML估计器保持渐近正态性，而允许另一个以任意慢的速度收敛或完全不收敛。
tldr: 本文提出校准去偏机器学习方法，通过等渗回归调整实现双重稳健渐近正态性，允许一个干扰函数慢速或不收敛，从而解决双重稳健估计中收敛速度不匹配的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces calibrated debiased machine learning, which achieves doubly robust asymptotic normality via isotonic regression adjustment, allowing one nuisance function to converge slowly or not at all.
